headline: A 2020 executive order aimed at protecting the nation's main electric power grid, the bulk-power system.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with the security of the bulk-power system, the large network of power plants and high-voltage lines that delivers electricity across the country. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and requirements in the order cannot be described here with confidence.

who_it_affects.group: Electric utilities and power grid operators
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses the security of the systems these companies own and run, though the specific requirements are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 1, 2020; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
